history.summary: Boutique 33-unit freehold whose apparent cheapness is a data artifact. Asking $1,162 psf is in line with the project's median (~$1,180 psf, range $1,090-$1,461), not below it. The algo's -29.7% age-adjusted and -13.3% cohort discounts rest on 1 cohort txn and 5 baseline-imputed appreciation txns, plus a bedroom/sqft mismatch (947 sqft is the top of the 1BR band, not a 1BR's true footprint). No real bargain and very thin liquidity.
history.rating_rationale: Verified project median PSF is ~$1,180 (range $1,090-$1,461); the $1,161.56 asking is mid-market, so the -29.7% age_adj_premium and -13.3% cohort discount are NOT real value once measured against actual transactions. Both signals are built on essentially 1 comparable (psf_cohort_txns=1) and a regional_baseline appreciation with only 5 txns, which per v3.4 priors is a likely DATA QUIRK rather than a bargain. Two red flags (very_low_psf, bedroom_sqft_mismatch) and a 33-unit boutique means very thin resale liquidity for a 5-7yr exit. Freehold is not a forward edge.
red_flags: psf_cohort_txns=1 and appreciation from regional_baseline on only 5 txns - cheapness signal is statistically empty
bedroom_sqft_mismatch: 947 sqft listed as 1BR (Wembly 1BR runs 560-947 sqft; this is the very top of band, possibly mis-tagged)
Asking $1,162 psf is at the project median (~$1,180), not below it - the -29.7% age_adj discount is an artifact
33-unit boutique = very thin transaction volume and poor exit liquidity
very_low_psf flag is not corroborated by actual recent transactions
catalysts: Freehold tenure in D19 (mild durability plus, not a forward price edge)
Yio Chu Kang Road location with bus connectivity and nearby amenities

agent_evaluation.rental_assessment: Boutique freehold near Yio Chu Kang; a ~947 sqft unit at $1.1M would need ~$3.3-3.6k/mo for ~3.6-3.9% gross yield, plausible but unremarkable for D19. Exit liquidity, not rent, is the binding constraint here.
